measurement_observation: The captured warm browser result has 1000 finite samples and unrounded p95 12.5 ms. An isolated reconstruction matches all installed assets; required metadata remains incomplete, so a full frozen protocol PASS is not independently established.

blocking_evidence_gaps.detail: Run report and raw output do not record CPU model, RAM, display refresh conditions, accepted document base revision/draft identity or explicit server-side advisory outcomes/errors as called for by frozen protocol. Resource Timing records document reads and asset requests, not an advisory validation request before result capture. A resource entry absence alone does not prove a request was never made.

qualified_findings: A post-run isolated rebuild of the hash-matched harness and source reproduced the recorded installed JS, CSS and HTML bytes; source inspection of the actual controller and two-rAF instrumentation is therefore supported by deterministic reconstructed byte equality under the declared build trust. The contemporaneously archived asset manifest remains stale.
The installation and restoration records say the server was freshly launched after installation and static files were restored; post-restoration active files were not inspected during this audit.
The reports record 100 warmups and 1000 measured events; raw output stores only measured samples and does not individually record all event identities or warmup observations.
The fixture contains server-prefixed declarations potentially foreign to the accepted document; no server acceptance follows from this preview run.
Cold-start series is NOT_CONDUCTED. Authoritative diagnostics, solver latency, named Firefox/Orca accessibility, full G2/G3 and commercial release remain outside this audit.
Two animation frame callbacks establish a prior-frame paint opportunity, not physical display presentation.

post_run_reconstruction.method: Post-run isolated Vite production build in /tmp from copied, individually hash-verified frontend/src and frontend/bench inputs plus pinned fixture; symlinked currently installed node_modules; no running server or active source/build directory touched.
post_run_reconstruction.scope: After-the-fact reproducibility establishes byte equality of the rebuilt bundle and recorded installed hashes, subject to the integrity of recorded installation hashes, source manifest, current dependencies and build tooling; it does not turn stale archived build manifest into contemporaneous evidence.
